India Tea Production, 2017 – March 2026

Output is flat at about 1,300–1,400 M kg a year and 2025 set the high mark (1,395.5 M kg). The big shift is structural: small growers now make 56.6% of India's tea, up from 49.3% in 2019.

Source: Tea Board of India production statistics (7 PDF releases), curated by src/extract.py. Units: million kg of made tea.
